# Figure 1

```{r format abundance table}
abundance.table.raw <- read.table("./data/abundances.wo-chimera.tsv", sep = ",", header = T)
names(abundance.table.raw) <- c("lib", "tax", "abundance")
abundance.table.raw$tax[abundance.table.raw$tax == "" | is.na(abundance.table.raw$tax)] <- "chloroplasts"
abundance.table.raw <- abundance.table.raw %>%
  mutate(tax = gsub("_m[0-9]*", "", tax))

associations <- read.table("./data/contaminations.csv", sep = ",", header = F)
names(associations) <- c("tax", "type")
associations.unique <- unique(associations)

contaminations <- associations.unique %>%
  filter(type == "contamination")

abundance.table.filtered <- abundance.table.raw %>%
  filter(!tax %in% contaminations$tax)

singletons <- abundance.table.filtered %>%
  group_by(tax) %>%
  filter(n_distinct(lib) == 1) %>%
  ungroup()

abundance.table.filtered <- abundance.table.filtered %>%
  filter(!tax %in% singletons$tax)

abundance.table.final <- abundance.table.filtered %>%
  group_by(lib) %>%
  mutate(abundance = abundance / sum(abundance)) %>%
  ungroup()
```

```{r plot abundance data}
abundance.md <- abundance.table.final %>%
  merge(metadata, by.x = "lib", by.y = "library")

## MAP 

world <- map_data("world")

abundance.md$longitude <- as.numeric(abundance.md$longitude)
abundance.md$latitude <- as.numeric(abundance.md$latitude)

map.p <- ggplot() +
 geom_polygon(data=world, aes(x=long, y=lat, group=group) , fill="grey")+
  theme_bw() +
 theme(panel.grid.major=element_blank(), panel.grid.minor=element_blank(),
    panel.border=element_blank()) +
 theme(axis.title=element_blank(), 
    axis.text=element_blank(), 
    axis.ticks=element_blank()) +
 geom_point(data=abundance.md, aes(x=longitude, y=latitude, shape=environment), size=2) +   theme(legend.position="none")

ggsave(map.p, file="./plots/Fig1b_map.pdf", width=170, height=110, units="mm", limitsize=F)


## ABUNDANCE

symbiont.order <- c("Aquarickettsia", "Grellia", "Benwitzia", "Megaira", "Rickettsiaceae", "Margulisbacteria", "Simkaniaceae", "Coxiellaceae", "Endozoicomonadaceae", "Terasakiellaceae", "Rhodobacteraceae", "Sphingomonadaceae", "Comamonadaceae", "Alcanivoracaceae1", "Marinobacteraceae", "Spongiibacteraceae", "Saccharospirillaceae", "Nitrincolaceae", "Burkholderiaceae", "Xanthomonadaceae", "Alteromonadaceae", "Gammaproteobacteria_bacterium_LS_SOB", "Salinisphaeraceae", "Pseudohongiellaceae", "Sutterellaceae", "Pseudoalteromonadaceae", "Halomonadaceae", "Vibrionaceae", "Methylophilaceae", "Colwelliaceae", "Idiomarinaceae", "Flavobacteriaceae", "Cyclobacteriaceae", "Spirosomaceae", "Babeliales")

host.order <- c("H4", "H15", "H11", "H7", "H8", "H6", "H2", "H3")

abundance.md$tax <- factor(abundance.md$tax, levels = symbiont.order)
abundance.md$type <- factor(abundance.md$type, levels = host.order)
abundance.md <- abundance.md %>%
  arrange(type, lib_old) %>% 
  mutate(lib_old = factor(lib_old, levels = unique(lib_old)))

abundance.p <- ggplot(abundance.md, aes(x = fct_rev(lib_old),  y = fct_rev(tax)))+
  geom_point(aes(size = abundance, fill = tax), shape = 21) +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(1,3),
                        guide = "legend",
                        name =" Relative abundance (%)") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = symbiont.colors) +
  theme_minimal() +
  guides(fill = "none") +
  theme(legend.position="bottom") + 
  scale_x_discrete(position="top") +
  theme(axis.text.x=element_text(angle = -90, hjust = 1, size = 5),
        axis.title.x=element_blank()) +
  theme(axis.text.y=element_text(size = 5),
        axis.title.y=element_blank())

ggsave(abundance.p, file="./plots/Fig1c_abundance.pdf", width=170, height=120, units="mm", limitsize=F)
```

# Figure 4 

```{r format and plot genome stats and transcriptomics}
genome.stats <- read.csv("./data/genome.stats.csv", sep = ",", header = T)

### Figure 4a

genomestats.p <- ggplot() +
  geom_point(data = genome.stats, aes(x = gc, y = size, fill = symbiont), size = 3, pch = 21) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = rick.colors) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

ggsave(genomestats.p, file="./plots/Fig4a_genomestats.pdf", width=70, height=70, units="mm", limitsize=F)


### Figure 4b

cog.data <- read.csv("./data/cog_cats.tsv", sep = "\t", header = T)
names(cog.data) <- c("genome","gene", "category")

cog.data <- cog.data %>%
  merge(genome.stats, by = "genome")

cog.counts.all <- cog.data %>%
  select(genome, symbiont, category) %>%
  group_by(genome, category, symbiont) %>%
  summarise(count = n(), .groups = "drop")

cog.counts.wide <- cog.counts.all %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = category, values_from = count, values_fill = 0)

count.cols <- cog.counts.wide %>%
  select(-genome, -symbiont)

count.cols.rel <- count.cols / rowSums(count.cols)
bc.dist <- vegdist(count.cols.rel, method = "bray")

set.seed(4)

nmds <- metaMDS(bc.dist, k = 2, trymax = 100)

nmds.df <- as.data.frame(nmds$points)
nmds.df$genome <- cog.counts.wide$genome
nmds.df$symbiont <- cog.counts.wide$symbiont 

cog.nmds.p <- ggplot(nmds.df, aes(x = MDS1, y = MDS2, color = symbiont, text = paste(genome)))+
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  scale_color_manual(values = rick.colors) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

ggsave(cog.nmds.p, file="./plots/Fig4b_cog_nmds.pdf", width=70, height=70, units="mm", limitsize=F)

### Figure 4c

tpm <- read.csv("./data/atp.tpm.csv", sep =",")
gene.names <- read.csv("./data/gene.names.tsv", sep ="\t", header = FALSE)
names(gene.names) <- c("target_id", "abbrev", "gene_name")

tpm <- tpm %>%
  merge(gene.names, by = "target_id")

tpm.atp <- tpm %>%
  filter(str_detect(gene_name, "ATP synthase|ADP,ATP"))

tpm.atp <- tpm.atp %>%
  mutate(cat = if_else(str_detect(gene_name, regex("ADP", ignore_case = TRUE)), "ADP", "ATP")) %>%
  mutate(sym = "Grellia") %>%
    mutate(host = case_when(str_detect(lib, "TR") ~ "Hawaii", TRUE ~ "Vienna"))
 
atp.tpm.boxplot.p <- ggplot(tpm.atp) +
  geom_boxplot(aes(x = interaction(sym, host), y = tpm, fill = interaction(sym, host))) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Grellia.Hawaii" = "#6286c4", "Grellia.Vienna" = "#6286c4")) +
  facet_wrap(~ cat, ncol = 1) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

ggsave(atp.tpm.boxplot.p, file="./plots/Fig4c_atp_tpm.pdf", width=40, height=70, units="mm", limitsize=F)
```

# Figure Supp 4

```{r distribution of ATP related genes}
atp <-  read.csv("./data/atp_adp.overview.tsv", sep = "\t", header = T)

genome.stats <- genome.stats %>%
  mutate(symbiont_haplotype_site = paste(symbiont, haplotype, site, sep = "_"))

atp <- atp %>%
  left_join(genome.stats %>% select(genome, symbiont_haplotype_site), by = "genome")

atp.pct <- atp %>%
  group_by(symbiont_haplotype_site, gene) %>%
  summarise(
    n_genomes_with_gene = n_distinct(genome),
    total_genomes = n_distinct(atp$genome[atp$symbiont_haplotype_site == unique(symbiont_haplotype_site)]),
    pct_genomes_with_gene = (n_genomes_with_gene / total_genomes) * 100,
    .groups = "drop")

atp.pct <- atp.pct %>%
  mutate(gene_type = ifelse(grepl("synthase", gene, ignore.case = TRUE),
                            "Synthase", "Translocase"))

atp.pct <- atp.pct %>%
  mutate(symbiont = str_extract(symbiont_haplotype_site, "^[^_]+"))

rickettsia.order <- c("Aquarickettsia", "Grellia", "Benwitzia", "Megaira")

atp.pct <- atp.pct %>%
  arrange(match(symbiont, rickettsia.order)) %>% 
  mutate(symbiont_haplotype_site = factor(symbiont_haplotype_site, levels = unique(symbiont_haplotype_site)))

atp.adp.heatmap.p <- ggplot(atp.pct, aes(x = symbiont_haplotype_site, y = gene, fill = pct_genomes_with_gene)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(pct_genomes_with_gene, 0)), size = 3) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "steelblue", name = "% Genomes") +
  facet_wrap(~ gene_type, ncol =1, scales = "free_y") + 
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1))

ggsave(atp.adp.heatmap.p, file="./plots/FigS4_heatmap_atp_adp.pdf", width=180, height=210, units="mm", limitsize=F)
```

# Table Supp 4

```{r check Rickettsiales presence on different levels}
# Summarise EMIRGE assemblies

rickettsia.taxa <- c("Aquarickettsia", "Grellia", "Benwitzia", "Megaira")
rickettsia.assembled <- metadata %>%
  distinct(library) %>%
  rename(lib = library) %>%
  left_join(
    abundance.table.final %>%
      filter(tax %in% rickettsia.taxa & !is.na(tax)) %>%
      distinct(lib, tax) %>% 
      mutate(present = "yes"),
    by = "lib") %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = tax,
    values_from = present,
    values_fill = "no") %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(rickettsia.taxa), ~replace_na(.x, "no"))) %>%
  select(lib, all_of(rickettsia.taxa))

rickettsia.assembled <- rickettsia.assembled %>%
  merge(lib.annotation, by.x = "lib", by.y = "library") %>%
  select(library_type_site, Aquarickettsia, Grellia, Benwitzia, Megaira) %>%
  rename(sample = library_type_site)

write_tsv(rickettsia.assembled, "./data/rickettsia.assembled.tsv")

# Summarise genome mapping

genome.mapping.out <- read.table("./data/reta-mapping.out.tsv", sep = "\t", header = F)
names(genome.mapping.out) <- c("lib", "genome", "mapped_genes", "all_genes")
genome.mapping.out <- genome.mapping.out %>%
  mutate(genome = sub("^[^.]+\\.", "", genome)) %>%
  mutate(genome = sub("\\.kallisto\\.out", "", genome)) 

genome.mapping.out <- genome.mapping.out %>%
  mutate(pct_mapped = (mapped_genes / all_genes) * 100)

genome.mapping.with_symbiont <- genome.mapping.out %>%
  left_join(genome.stats %>% select(genome, symbiont), by = "genome")

genome.mapping.summary <- genome.mapping.with_symbiont %>%
  group_by(lib, symbiont) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_pct_mapped = mean(pct_mapped, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_pct_mapped = sd(pct_mapped, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_genomes = n(),
    .groups = "drop")

rickettsia.genome.mapped <- genome.mapping.summary %>%
  select(lib, symbiont, mean_pct_mapped) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = symbiont,
    values_from = mean_pct_mapped,
    values_fill = NA)

rickettsia.genome.mapped <- rickettsia.genome.mapped %>%
  merge(lib.annotation, by.x = "lib", by.y = "library") %>%
  select(library_type_site, Aquarickettsia, Grellia, Benwitzia, Megaira) %>%
  rename(sample = library_type_site)

write_tsv(rickettsia.genome.mapped, "./data/rickettsia.genome.mapped.tsv")
```
